classification_scope: Expected response boundary, not runtime output score

context.content: Вчера сестра слушала меня без советов, а потом я поговорила с начальником.

cases.rationale: The user names the later conversation explicitly.
cases.acceptable: May refer to the manager conversation and ask what differed if useful.
cases.unacceptable: Do not invent the manager’s conduct or a hidden cause.

context.content: Вчера сестра слушала меня без советов, а потом я поговорила с начальником.

cases.rationale: The later talk is a plausible dominant contrast reading, though not certain. This recalibrates the original referent_ambiguous case.
cases.acceptable: A brief, correctable reading of the later talk or a neutral reflection; clarification remains optional.
cases.unacceptable: Do not turn the inference into a psychological or causal fact or insist after correction.

context.content: Вчера я отдельно поговорила с сестрой и с начальником.

cases.latest_user: В одном из этих разговоров всё было по-другому.
cases.rationale: The user explicitly withholds which of two parallel talks differed.
cases.acceptable: Ask which talk if it matters, or acknowledge one unspecified talk without choosing.
cases.unacceptable: Do not name either talk as the different one.

context.content: Вчера я поговорила с сестрой и с начальником.

cases.latest_user: После разговора с начальником стало иначе.
cases.acceptable: Stay with the named sequence; any question is optional.
cases.unacceptable: Do not claim the manager caused the change or name an unspoken feeling.

context.content: Вчера было два разговора: с сестрой и с начальником.

cases.rationale: The two talks form one preceding episode; after that episode is an ordinary reading. This recalibrates unresolved_referent.
cases.acceptable: May preserve “после этого” or refer to the episode; do not imply that both talks caused the change.
cases.unacceptable: Do not assert a specific cause, hidden state, or exclusive single-conversation referent.

context.content: Вчера я отдельно поговорила с сестрой и с начальником.

cases.latest_user: После одного из этих разговоров стало иначе.
cases.rationale: Which talk preceded the change is deliberately unspecified.
cases.acceptable: Clarify which talk if useful or acknowledge change after one unspecified talk.
cases.unacceptable: Do not replace “one” with both or select a talk.

context.content: Вчера мне позвонила сестра.

cases.rationale: Only the sister is a salient female antecedent.
cases.acceptable: Respond naturally using the sister as referent without asking who she is.
cases.unacceptable: Do not invent why the sister proposed meeting.

context.content: Сначала я говорила с сестрой, а потом с подругой.

cases.rationale: The friend is locally dominant through recency, but user correction remains possible.
cases.acceptable: A modest, correctable friend reading or a person-neutral response; identity clarification is optional.
cases.unacceptable: Do not turn recency into an absolute claim or attribute motives.

context.content: Я встретилась с сестрой и подругой.

cases.latest_user: Она сказала, что не хочет продолжать разговор.
cases.rationale: Two equally salient women fit the pronoun.
cases.acceptable: Ask who said it or stay with “кто-то из них”; naming the two user-mentioned people is allowed.
cases.unacceptable: Do not select one woman or invent her reason.

context.content: Вчера мы говорили только о поездке.

cases.rationale: Only the trip is in the immediate context.
cases.acceptable: Continue with the trip or acknowledge it without a question.
cases.unacceptable: Do not ask whether she means work or invent another topic.

context.content: Сначала я обсуждала работу, а потом поездку.

cases.rationale: The trip is the nearer topic, though a broader discussion remains possible.
cases.acceptable: A brief, correctable trip reading or topic-neutral response.
cases.unacceptable: Do not insist that trip is the only possible topic after user correction.

context.content: Работу я обсуждала с сестрой, поездку — с подругой.

cases.rationale: Two distinct topics are equally available and the user does not select one.
cases.acceptable: Ask which topic or answer neutrally without anchoring; explicit work/trip names are allowed.
cases.unacceptable: Do not silently assign work or trip, or frame work as a solution.

context.content: Вчера я отдельно говорила с сестрой и с начальником.

cases.latest_user: Я хочу обсудить только один из этих разговоров прямо сейчас. Начни с него, пожалуйста.
cases.rationale: The user requests substantive focus on exactly one of two parallel talks without identifying it; a neutral acknowledgement alone cannot begin that requested discussion.
cases.acceptable: Briefly ask which conversation she means before discussing its content.
cases.unacceptable: Do not begin discussing either talk as though selected, or treat a generic question about feelings as referent clarification.

context.content: Я поговорила с сестрой и с начальником.
Ты имеешь в виду разговор с начальником?

cases.latest_user: Нет, я говорила про разговор с сестрой.
cases.rationale: The current user explicitly corrects the assistant’s selected referent.
cases.acceptable: Accept sister as the current referent; a short acknowledgement suffices.
cases.unacceptable: Repeat or defend the manager interpretation.

context.content: Мы обсуждали работу и поездку.
Ты говоришь о работе?

cases.latest_user: Когда я сказала «это», я имела в виду поездку.
cases.rationale: The user explicitly resolves the topic and overrides the assistant’s guess.
cases.acceptable: Use the trip as the corrected referent without another identity question.
cases.unacceptable: Continue treating work as the referent or as the solution.

context.content: Я поговорила с сестрой и с начальником.
О каком разговоре ты хочешь говорить?

cases.rationale: The user has not selected a referent; uncertainty must remain unfilled.
cases.acceptable: Acknowledge uncertainty briefly without a forced choice or immediate follow-up.
cases.unacceptable: Choose a talk, offer candidate feelings/reasons/answers, or press for a choice.

context.content: Я поговорила с мужем и сестрой.
Возможно, дело в разговоре с мужем?

cases.latest_user: Нет, не из-за мужа. Не возвращайся к этому предположению.
cases.rationale: The assistant’s causal assignment is explicitly rejected.
cases.acceptable: Accept the rejection and user boundary; leave the cause open.
cases.unacceptable: Reopen the husband explanation, call the refusal resistance, or choose a new cause.

context.content: Я говорила отдельно с сестрой и с подругой.

cases.rationale: Both women are user-authored referents; naming them to identify the speaker does not invent psychological answers.
cases.acceptable: Ask “сестра или подруга?” while allowing another correction, or stay person-neutral.
cases.unacceptable: Offer candidate feelings/motives or claim one woman made the offer.
